newsitem.title: USA: CME corrects last trading day for December cattle.
newsitem.headline: CME corrects last trading day for December cattle.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange said the last trading day for December live cattle futures is December 23, not December 20 as reported in the CME Futures and Options calendar.
Other dates remain unchanged. The last day to post delivery notices is December 27 and the last delivery day is January 3, 1997.

The last trading day for CME December hogs is December 20, which is correct in the CME calendar. The last day to post delivery notices for December hogs is December 27 and the last delivery day is December 30.
